promises.claim: Each card’s monthly credit report scores your record on Credit Used, counted across every card’s limit.
promises.holds: Each card’s month reports what’s used across every open card’s limit (src/engine/systems/credit.ts:1324)

promises.claim: Each day something here worries you, it adds stress and takes morale.
promises.holds: Each midnight, a day in trouble adds stress and takes morale (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:508)

promises.claim: Tax owed worries you each day like a debt, though it’s on Papers and Owed leaves it out.
promises.holds: Tax owed is among the troubles the day’s worry reads; Owed lists only accounts owing (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:483; src/ui/looks/money.tsx:500)
promises.why: The worry from tax owed is the same `inTrouble` the overdraft’s is (b20-money-promises), and What Needs You counts tax owed (evidence2-b11); no test plays tax owed and reads the stress it adds, or opens Owed beside it to see it left out.

promises.claim: Every balance here counts in your net worth, and your primary account’s balance is the first figure on Home’s Money line.
promises.holds: Net worth sums every account; the Money line opens on the primary account (src/engine/systems/finance.ts:64)

promises.claim: A standing order needs a savings account to pay into, and Savings Covers The Checking Account uses easy-access savings at the same bank as the checking account a payment comes from.
promises.holds: A standing order goes only into savings; the link covers easy-access savings at the bank of each account a payment comes from (src/engine/systems/payments.ts:267; src/engine/systems/payments.ts:133)

promises.claim: Move Money appears on this tab once you have two accounts.
promises.holds: Move Money is drawn once there are two accounts (src/ui/workspaces/BankWorkspace.tsx:210)
promises.why: Presentation: no test was found that renders the Accounts tab with one account and then two and reads Move Money appearing.

promises.claim: Your primary account’s bank runs the overdraft your day-to-day spending can run into.
promises.holds: The day’s spending runs into the primary account’s overdraft, by its bank’s way (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:389)

promises.claim: Cash comes out of your primary account, at its bank’s machines and fees.
promises.holds: Cash comes out of the primary account at its bank’s rules (src/engine/systems/cash.ts:127)

promises.claim: An account you don’t use becomes inactive, then dormant, and after the country’s number of years its money goes to the state.
promises.holds: Inactive, dormant, then the state (src/engine/systems/accountlife.ts:722)

promises.claim: Move Money appears only once you have two accounts.
promises.holds: Move Money is drawn once there are two accounts (src/ui/workspaces/BankWorkspace.tsx:210)
promises.why: Presentation: no test was found that renders the tab with one account and reads Move Money absent.

promises.claim: Money sent to your account at another bank arrives on the day the sending bank’s own rule sets, or where it sets none, its country’s. Where neither says, the game estimates ${businessDays(ESTIMATE_SEND_DAYS)}.
promises.holds: The sending bank’s days, or its country’s, or SLATE’s estimate (src/engine/systems/bankmoves.ts:170)

promises.claim: A move counts as using both accounts, which keeps them from becoming inactive. A dormant account refuses it until you reactivate it.
promises.holds: A move counts as using both accounts; a dormant one refuses it (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:710; src/engine/systems/banking.ts:974)

promises.claim: A standing order or a payment set for a date makes the same move on a day you choose.
promises.holds: A standing order and a payment set for a date make the same move on their day (src/engine/systems/payments.ts:198)

promises.claim: A term deposit is paid for from your checking account at the same bank.
promises.holds: A term deposit is paid for from the checking account at its bank (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:1584)

promises.claim: What it holds counts in your worth from the day it opens, though you can’t spend it.
promises.holds: A term deposit is an account of theirs, counted in worth (src/engine/systems/finance.ts:71)

promises.claim: The bank’s notice before the end, and the renewal or payout on the day, come to What Needs You.
promises.holds: The bank’s notice before the end, and the renewal or payout, are notices (src/engine/systems/accountlife.ts:545; src/engine/systems/lending.ts:1310)

promises.claim: Where the country gives a cooling-off period, you can cancel a new term deposit during it without a penalty.
promises.holds: Canceled in a cooling-off period without a penalty, where the country gives one (src/engine/systems/accountlife.ts:625)
promises.why: No current life reaches a cooling-off period: the US gives none, and a bank abroad opens nothing new for a customer abroad. Held on fixture lives (Canada); left to the owner’s banking decisions, as bank.cancel_new.

promises.claim: A Payment Over set at or under a stranger’s charge tells you the day it happens, so you know of it from then: in the US, a debit card charge reported within ${clockOf(DEBIT_PROMPT, 'of')} costs you at most ${usd(DEBIT_PROMPT.max ?? 0)}.
promises.holds: A Payment Over set at or under a stranger’s charge is told the day it happens, and the US debit liability reads when it was learned of (src/engine/systems/security.ts:406; src/engine/systems/security.ts:182)

promises.claim: Short For A Payment watches each standing order and payment set for a date, ${LOOKAHEAD_DAYS} days ahead.
promises.holds: Short For A Payment lists standing orders and payments set for a date within three days (src/engine/systems/obligations.ts:54)

promises.claim: Short For A Payment watches each card’s autopay against the account it pays from.
promises.holds: Short For A Payment lists each card’s autopay against the account it pays from and the savings linked there (src/engine/systems/obligations.ts:62)

promises.claim: Alerts, the dormancy notice and the bank’s letter before it hands money over come to What Needs You.
promises.holds: Alerts and the dormancy notice are notices; the letter before the state is a decision with Keep The Account; What Needs You shows both (src/engine/systems/accountlife.ts:742; src/ui/screens/Home.tsx:233)

promises.claim: A term deposit’s end and breaking it early are handled on the same panel.
promises.holds: The term deposit’s end and Break It are on Your Accounts Over Time (src/ui/bank/BankAccountLife.tsx:84)

promises.claim: Round-ups are set on the same panel, where your bank offers them.
promises.holds: Round-Ups is drawn on Your Accounts Over Time where the bank offers them (src/ui/bank/RoundUps.tsx:82)

promises.claim: What the debit card pays rounds up, and at Citi, BBVA México and Santander México what their own credit card pays too: How You Pay sets whether the day goes on the debit card, the credit card or in cash.
promises.holds: What the debit card pays rounds up, and at Citi, BBVA México and Santander México their own credit card’s too (corrected 2026-10-21 from “only the debit card”) (src/engine/systems/roundups.ts:154; src/engine/systems/spending.ts:389)

promises.claim: Each transfer is a move from your checking account into savings at the same bank, on the bank’s day.
promises.holds: Each transfer moves from checking into savings at the same bank on the bank’s day (src/engine/systems/roundups.ts:199)

promises.claim: Round-ups are set under Your Accounts Over Time, with term deposits and unused accounts.
promises.holds: Round-Ups is drawn under Your Accounts Over Time (src/ui/bank/RoundUps.tsx:82)

promises.claim: Paying the day in cash first needs cash, taken out under Cash on the same tab.
promises.holds: Paid in cash first, the day spends cash in hand (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:330)

promises.claim: On The Credit Card puts each day’s groceries on your everyday card, and its statement and your credit record move with them.
promises.holds: On The Credit Card puts the groceries on the everyday card; its statement and record follow (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:358)

promises.claim: A debit card purchase the account can’t cover goes into the overdraft only where the bank allows it. Chase asks you to opt in.
promises.holds: A debit purchase goes into the overdraft only where the bank may pay it there; Chase asks (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:335)

promises.claim: A meal you pay for or have delivered is paid the way The Day’s Spending says.
promises.holds: A meal is paid as the day is (src/engine/systems/life.ts:474)

promises.claim: Have Wages Paid Here reaches Yale’s payroll after ${PAYER_LEAD['yale-payroll']} days, and your shift pay goes there from then.
promises.holds: Wages paid to the new account after Yale’s lead days (src/engine/systems/routing.ts:56)

promises.claim: Short For A Payment warns you ${LOOKAHEAD_DAYS} days ahead when an account can’t cover a standing order or a payment set for a date.
promises.holds: Short For A Payment within three days of a standing order or a payment set for a date (src/engine/systems/obligations.ts:58)

promises.claim: In Cash, Then The Debit Card spends your cash on the day first.
promises.holds: Paid in cash first, the day spends cash in hand (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:330)

promises.claim: A cash advance goes on your everyday card at once, and is charged its cash rate from the day you take it.
promises.holds: A cash advance goes on the card and draws its cash rate from the first night (src/engine/systems/cash.ts:232; src/engine/systems/credit.ts:1035)

promises.claim: A machine needs your debit card, arrived and unlocked. With a locked, stopped or new card, only the counter works.
promises.holds: A machine needs the debit card arrived and unlocked; the counter doesn’t (src/engine/systems/cash.ts:130)

promises.claim: Cash you carry counts in your worth, with what’s in the bank.
promises.holds: Cash In Hand counts in worth (src/engine/systems/finance.ts:71)

promises.claim: What you owe on a card counts against your worth at once, and Owed shows its rate and Credit Used.
promises.holds: A card owing counts against worth; Owed shows its rate and Credit Used (src/engine/systems/finance.ts:65)

promises.claim: On The Credit Card, in How You Pay, puts each day’s groceries on your everyday card.
promises.holds: On The Credit Card puts the groceries on the everyday card (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:358)

promises.claim: Its introductory rate, rewards, money transfers and payment plans are under The Card’s Offers on the same tab.
promises.holds: The Card’s Offers is drawn on the Cards tab with the card (src/ui/bank/BankCardOffers.tsx:87)
promises.why: Presentation: no test renders the Cards tab and reads The Card’s Offers beside the card’s panel.

promises.claim: A card that’s locked or reported has nothing Left To Spend until it’s unlocked or the new one arrives.
promises.holds: A locked or reported card has no room (src/engine/systems/credit.ts:582)

promises.claim: The credit record your card payments build is what a bank looks at to arrange an overdraft or lend to you, and at what rate.
promises.holds: The record prices a loan and decides it; an arranged overdraft too, where a bank arranges one (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:505)

promises.claim: A statement with a payment due, a late payment, a failed autopay and a raised limit all come to What Needs You.
promises.holds: A statement with a payment due, a late payment, a bounced autopay and a raised limit are notices (src/engine/systems/statements.ts:478; src/engine/systems/credit.ts:958)

promises.claim: Offers come with a card, and a balance from another bank’s card moves when you apply for the new one.
promises.holds: The offers are the card’s terms; a balance moves when the new card arrives (src/engine/systems/cardoffers.ts:223)

promises.claim: A money transfer adds to what you owe on the card and to your checking account at once.
promises.holds: A money transfer owes on the card and pays checking at once (src/engine/systems/cardoffers.ts:229)
promises.why: No current life reaches a money transfer: only NatWest’s, Santander España’s and Bankinter’s cards offer one (card.money_transfer). Held on a London fixture life.

promises.claim: A Payment Over, set low enough, tells you about a stranger’s charge the day it happens.
promises.holds: A Payment Over, set low enough, tells of a stranger’s charge the day it happens (src/engine/systems/security.ts:406)

promises.claim: A credit card that’s locked or reported has nothing Left To Spend until it’s unlocked or replaced.
promises.holds: A locked or reported credit card has no room (src/engine/systems/credit.ts:582)

promises.claim: With the debit card locked or stopped, the day’s groceries go on the credit card or are paid in cash.
promises.holds: A locked or stopped debit card: the groceries on the credit card or in cash (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:344)

promises.claim: A machine needs the debit card. While it’s locked, stopped or hasn’t arrived, only the counter pays out.
promises.holds: A machine needs the debit card (src/engine/systems/cash.ts:130)

promises.claim: A debt sent to collections stays in Owed until it’s paid.
promises.holds: Owed lists a debt in collections until it’s paid (src/ui/looks/money.tsx:500)

promises.claim: Your credit record decides whether a bank arranges an overdraft or lends, and at what rate. A debt sent to collections and a missed loan payment lower it.
promises.holds: The record decides a loan and its rate; a charge-off and a missed loan payment mark it (src/engine/systems/credit.ts:1256; src/engine/systems/lending.ts:1345)

promises.claim: An account closed for being overdrawn sends your money to another account of yours, and a ChexSystems report can make the next bank turn you away.
promises.holds: An account closed for an overdraft sends the money to another account of theirs and files ChexSystems (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:1049)

promises.claim: How You Pay decides what can reach the overdraft: a bill always can, a debit card purchase only where the bank allows it.
promises.holds: A bill draws the overdraft; a debit purchase only where the bank may (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:223; src/engine/systems/spending.ts:327)

promises.claim: Each day your primary account is overdrawn or a debt is in collections, it worries you.
promises.holds: Overdrawn and collections are troubles the day’s worry reads (src/engine/systems/spending.ts:466)

promises.claim: A new bank asks for a valid photo ID: a passport, a driver’s license or an ID card.
promises.holds: A new bank asks for a valid photo ID (src/engine/systems/bankmoves.ts:102)

promises.claim: Before the old account closes, wages, standing orders, autopay and loan payments have to be moved off it, and payments set for a date to or from it canceled.
promises.holds: Close It refuses while wages, orders, autopay, a loan or a payment set for a date touch the account (src/engine/systems/bankmoves.ts:290)

promises.claim: Money between your banks arrives in the sending bank’s own days or by its cut-off time, or where it sets none, by its country’s system. Where neither says, the game estimates ${businessDays(ESTIMATE_SEND_DAYS)}.
promises.holds: The sending bank’s days or cut-off, or its country’s system, or SLATE’s estimate (src/engine/systems/bankmoves.ts:170)

promises.claim: Make Primary on the new account puts its bank at the top of Money, and your day-to-day spending comes out of it.
promises.holds: Make Primary moves the day’s spending to the account (src/engine/systems/bankmoves.ts:480)

promises.claim: A second bank lends or arranges an overdraft on its own terms. Choose it in Borrow At.
promises.holds: Each bank lends on its own terms, chosen in Borrow At (src/engine/systems/lending.ts:471)

promises.claim: Your accounts at home are among your accounts from the first morning, beside the American ones.
promises.holds: The accounts at home are opened with the life (src/engine/systems/homeaccount.ts:270)

promises.claim: The bank there pays its interest and charges its own fee at the month’s end, as any bank does.
promises.holds: The month’s end pays interest and charges the fee at any bank, a fee abroad beside it (src/engine/systems/banking.ts:932)

promises.claim: Money moves between it and your American account as a payment abroad, counting both countries’ business days.
promises.holds: Between it and the American account, a payment abroad in both countries’ business days (src/engine/systems/abroad.ts:406)

promises.claim: Each February’s return reports its interest by its country, and a US citizen is told there about the FBAR and Form 8938.
promises.holds: The return reports its interest by country, and a US citizen is told of the FBAR and Form 8938 (src/engine/systems/abroad.ts:560)
